links.outcome: LLM hallucination rate in urinalysis report interpretation
links.effect: Claude-4.5 had the lowest hallucination rate (7.5%); common hallucinations included misinterpretation, definition errors, and over-interpretation.
links.quote: Regarding safety, Claude-4.5 exhibited the lowest hallucination rate (7.5 %).

links.outcome: Performance variability across testing instrument platforms and flag interpretation
links.effect: Models performed suboptimally in interpreting instrument flags; instrument-dependent variability was observed (Sysmex vs. Mindray, p<0.001).
links.quote: Instrument-dependent variability was observed (Sysmex vs. Mindray, p<0.001).

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of five LLMs interpreting retrospective real-world urinalysis reports, rated offline by certified laboratory technologists and physicians.
